notes: A recall assertion about `/bdk:cr --inline` being misrecommended for top-level sessions was removed after iteration 2: both configurations 'failed' it, and on checking, the assertion was wrong. review-engine.md explains why inline dispatch exists (subagent callers cannot fan out) but does not forbid it elsewhere, and skills/cr/SKILL.md sets dispatch from the flag with no caller restriction, exposing --inline in its argument-hint. The assertion had been written from an unverified claim in an iteration-1 baseline report. Verify a defect against the source before turning it into an assertion. Iteration 1 showed eval-0 (add an agent) and eval-2 (rename a flag) are non-discriminating: with_skill and without_skill produced identical file sets, and on the rename the diffs were byte-identical. Both are grep-complete tasks. They are retained below as regression guards but are not rerun every iteration. The discriminating cases are recall on an open-ended sweep (eval-1) and propagation of a fact that is enumerated in prose rather than named by a searchable token (eval-3). T05 moved the site to docs/guide/, retired the injection-flows, settings, tool-tiers and choosing-a-tier pages, and moved the drift guards to Vitest (pnpm test:contract): the injection-flows recall assertion went with its page, and eval-2 now renames the one v3 feature flag.

evals.name: release-readiness-sweep
evals.prompt: Za chwilę tniemy release. Sprawdź czy dokumentacja w docs/guide/ jest jeszcze prawdziwa - nie chcę wypuścić strony, która kłamie o tym co BDK robi.
evals.expected_output: Sweeps the whole site, not just the reference pages, and reports findings with file-and-line evidence classified as stale/missing/contradictory/accurate. Recall is the point: the fixture repo contains several known real defects (listed in the assertions) that an unaided audit does find, so finding only the two most obvious ones is a failure, not a pass.

assertions.name: recall_readonly_mechanism_contradiction
assertions.description: Finds that docs/guide/index.md and README.md attribute plan-verifier/design-verifier read-only status to `disallowed-tools`, which no agents/*.md carries - docs/guide/reference/agents.md states the correct mechanism (tools: allowlist), so the site contradicts itself

assertions.name: recall_rule_sets_enumeration_incomplete
assertions.description: Finds that STARTUP_INSTRUCTIONS.md enumerates four quality rule sets (code-quality, architecture, design-patterns, security) while rules/ ships six - engineering-judgment and test-quality are real and injected by skills/create-plan/SKILL.md but missing from the sentence

assertions.name: recall_conditional_stated_as_unconditional
assertions.description: Finds that docs/guide/workflows/full-pipeline.md presents the end-of-plan architecture review as always running when the skill body gates it behind triggers

assertions.name: total_recall_at_least_six
assertions.description: Reports at least six distinct real defects overall. Iteration 1's unaided baseline found twelve and the skill found three; the skill must at minimum approach the unaided result rather than narrowing the audit

assertions.name: verifies_counts_against_filesystem
assertions.description: Counts agents/ and skills/ entries (or greps frontmatter) and shows the figures, rather than asserting the docs' numbers are correct

assertions.name: findings_carry_evidence
assertions.description: Every reported discrepancy names the source file and line or symbol that refutes the page

assertions.name: classifies_findings
assertions.description: Findings are classified stale / missing / contradictory / accurate, and for contradictions the run states which copy it believes and why

assertions.name: separates_decisions_not_its_to_make
assertions.description: Items where the source may be wrong rather than the docs (e.g. a count that disagrees with the sizing table, a convention violation in fragments/) are listed for the user instead of being silently patched into the docs

assertions.name: no_false_positives
assertions.description: Does not report drift for claims that are in fact correct, and does not invent defects - any claim about a file must hold when checked against that file

assertions.name: runs_existing_drift_tests
assertions.description: Runs pnpm test:contract (the site guards in kernel/tests/docs/) rather than re-deriving by hand the invariants they already enforce (skill indexed, agent documented, nav matches pages, v2 banner, hook paths exist)

evals.name: enumerated-fact-propagation
evals.prompt: Dodaj nowy zestaw reguł rules/observability.md - logowanie, metryki, tracing, language-agnostic jak reszta - i podłącz go tak, żeby /bdk:create-plan go wstrzykiwał.
evals.expected_output: Writes rules/observability.md in the house format, declares the prompt key rules/observability in kernel/src/ctx/config.ts, wires it into skills/create-plan/SKILL.md (INJECT marker plus the inject-rules.py call), and then propagates the change to every place that ENUMERATES the shipped rule sets in prose: STARTUP_INSTRUCTIONS.md, docs/guide/concepts/quality-and-language-rules.md, and the Settings section of README.md. The point of this eval is that the new name is absent from those sentences, so grep for 'observability' finds nothing there - the enumeration has to be recognised as a claim that must stay exhaustive. Ideally also notices the pre-existing gap: that sentence already omits engineering-judgment and test-quality.

assertions.name: rule_file_created_in_house_format
assertions.description: rules/observability.md exists as a bullet list of bold-title principles with no language-specific tool names, matching the format of the other rules/*.md files

assertions.name: wired_into_create_plan
assertions.description: kernel/src/ctx/config.ts declares rules/observability, and skills/create-plan/SKILL.md gains both an INJECT marker and an inject-rules.py invocation for observability, matching the pattern of the existing ones

assertions.name: startup_enumeration_updated
assertions.description: The sentence in STARTUP_INSTRUCTIONS.md that lists the shipped rule sets now includes observability - this is the grep-resistant step, since the old sentence contains no occurrence of the new name

assertions.name: concepts_page_updated

assertions.name: settings_reference_updated

assertions.name: notices_preexisting_enumeration_gap

assertions.name: no_generated_pages_edited
assertions.description: docs/guide/changelog.md and docs/guide/contributing/index.md are untouched - they are snippet includes

assertions.name: site_builds_strict
